question: Should `channelData.openclawProgressKind` with `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for progress producers and channel plugins?
rationale: The bug fix needs a generic cross-plugin ownership seam, but exporting a new Plugin SDK API commits OpenClaw to an external compatibility contract; repository policy requires maintainer intent rather than inferring that direction from implementation alone.

options.title: Approve the generic public contract
options.body: Keep the current generic API, document authorized producers and channel semantics, and add focused public-contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and provide a non-public host-owned seam if external plugins should not rely on this metadata.

options.title: Pause this API direction
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers choose a broader portable progress-presentation contract shared by additional channels.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current generic API, document authorized producers and channel semantics, and add focused public-contract coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most strongly to both the Slack delivery architecture and public Plugin SDK contract decisions affected by the PR.
